CBSE Board Class 10th, 12th Date Sheet 2027 – Full Details

Short Details : Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has recently released the exam date sheet of Class X & Class XII board exam today. CBSE Class X exam will be held from 16 February to 09 March 2027 and the CBSE Class XII Exams will be held from 16 February to 09 April 2027. Candidates must check the complete details for CBSE Board Class 10th, 12th Date Sheet 2027 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • CBSE Board Exam Date Sheet Issued : 06 November 2026
  • Class 10th (Xth) Annual Exam Date : 16 February 2027 to 09 March 2027
  • Class 12th (XIIth) Annual Exam Date : 16 February 2027 to 09 April 2027
  • Candidates can check their Timing, Shifts in the File Provided.
